name: Kinshin Bokan ~Kyou mo Mata, Okaa-san ga Boku o Motomete Kuru~
original_name: 近親母姦 ～今日もまた、お母さんがぼくを求めてくる～
source: The protagonist, Miyasaka Takayuki, is lying in bed trying to fall asleep when his mother, Miyasaka Kaori, enters the room and asks if he's asleep. Takayuki has flashbacks to a time when his family was happy before his father died and his mother remarried. Kaori has developed an unhealthy obsession with her son and they engage in a twisted relationship. Takayuki knows that this cannot continue and hopes that his mother will come to the same realization.
translation: 主角宫坂贵之躺在床上想要入睡，这时他的母亲宫坂香织走进房间，问他是否睡着了。贵之回忆起父亲去世、母亲再婚之前一家人幸福的时光。香织对儿子产生了一种不健康的痴迷，他们的关系变得扭曲。孝之知道这种情况不能再继续下去，并希望他的母亲也能有同样的认识。
